A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''security officer''' worked in the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]{{'s}} security office during the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] murder investigation of the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Tanith Sorn]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. This security officer allowed the ''Executor''{{'s}} investigation team to review security footage of the crime scene.
